summary.en: Intertitles on the strip, each pulled into the gate by one claw pull-down and held while read; the first scene runs the strip in and brakes on the first title; a line may light the optical track.
summary.zh: 胶片上的字幕卡，每张由抓片爪拉进片门、停住读完；开场时胶片跑进来刹在第一张上；某一行可以点亮光学声轨。

fits: A hook or a claim in two to four short lines.
notFor: Long sentences; more than four lines in a row.

intent.en: Words arrive as frames of the film itself, one pull-down at a time.
intent.zh: 文字作为胶片本身的画格到来，一次拉一格。

content.en: 1–4 lines (≤ 3 words / 8 字 each); optionally a line that lights the track.
content.zh: 1–4 行（每行 ≤ 3 词 / 8 字）；可选一行点亮声轨。

fits.zh: 用两到四行短句讲钩子或主张。

pairs.note: the frames follow on the same reel

en: Declare the lead: the first pull-down belongs to the scene before.
zh: 声明 lead：第一次拉片属于上一场。

fits: any film about films, frames or renders

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
